page.layout: One block of running text, full width, with two short paragraphs marked by numbers set as centred Roman numerals (XCII., XCIII.) and a closing reference line for each. Page number and running head at the top, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: sapiente constructam dissoluat, deleta homi-nis forma quam ille statuerat, atq; lapillos illos transferat quibus efficiat formam canis aut vlupis, quam etiam malè struat: postea definiat ac dicat hanc esse pulchram illam regis imaginem, quam sapiens artifex construxerat, ostensis lapillis istis, qui à primo artifice pulchrè compositi fuerant in regis imaginem, malè vero translati à posteriore in formam canis, ac per phantasiam lapillorum astutè fallat imperitos, qui regiæ formæ notionem non habent, persuadeatq; hanc turpem canis formam esse pulchram illam imaginem regis: Eodem sanè modò hi confarcinant fabulas anicularum, quibus posteà verba, dictiones & parabolas hinc inde euulsas applicant, & fabulis suis adaptare volunt eloquia Dei. Ibidem.

Quemadmodum ii qui in phreneticum affectum lapsi, quo plus rident & se valere putant, ac tanquam sani omnia peragunt, quædam verò etiam plus quàm sani, tanto peius se habent: similiter & isti, qui sapientia præcellere videntur, ac seipsos eneruant, tanto magis desipiunt, quanto supra vires iaculantur. Eodem lib. I. c. 13.
Nemo est perfectus inter ipsos, qui non magna mendacia veluti fructus producit. Eodem libro, cap. 15.

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. Printed as they stand: "vlupis" (for vulpis) and "sanè" are the printer's spellings. The word "ridẹnt" is printed "rident" with a faint mark over the e, read as rident. The catchword "Adfe-" is read from the lower right; the f is taken as a true f.
